properties.name: One composed check runs over the hub and any set of its designs, and says which findings belong to which design and to each pair
properties.statement: compose_and_analyse takes a list of designs (committed exports, or the designs a hub pins) instead of one other design, composes each under its own namespace in memory, and attributes every finding to one design or to a pair (for example ansible×bluesky-tiled-plugins), so seams between two members are analysed even when neither is the design calling. It is still built in memory and thrown away: no design, the hub's included, changes (its export's content hash is the same afterwards). Today it takes one `other` and one namespace (compose.rs:117-205), so a hub effort spanning 3-6 designs is run pairwise and stitched by hand. Distinct from req:two-or-more-designs-are-compared-on-one-topic-on-demand, which compares topic neighbourhoods side by side rather than composing whole designs.
